synthesis:draft.headline: VIC1 RRP peaked at 406.00544 $/MWh at 2026-08-20 09:10 AEST (interval end 2026-08-19T23:10:00Z).
summary: The five-minute RRP peak is 406.00544 $/MWh at interval end 2026-08-19T23:10:00Z (2026-08-20 09:10 AEST) [ev0445].
Six five-minute intervals met the analysis threshold of 300.0 $/MWh in the window [ev0893], threshold = 300.0 $/MWh [ev0894].
Operational demand in the half-hour containing the price extreme (interval ending 2026-08-19T23:30:00Z / 2026-08-20 09:30 AEST) is 6812.0 MW [ev0919].
Maximum operational demand in the window is 7485.0 MW at interval ending 2026-08-20T08:30:00Z (2026-08-20 18:30 AEST) [ev0937].
Dispatch net interchange at the price peak (interval end 2026-08-19T23:10:00Z) is -718.24 MW (net flow into VIC1) [ev0447].

possible_explanations.statement: The spike might be associated with operational demand being higher than the public POE50 forecasts around the peak (see AEMO forecast vs actual pairs for target end 2026-08-19T23:00:00Z and 2026-08-19T23:30:00Z) [compare_forecast_actual entries ev1016, ev1020].
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare AEMO public forecast runs and the POE50 values with actuals and rebid logs for the targets covering 2026-08-19T23:00:00Z and 2026-08-19T23:30:00Z (AEMO compare_forecast_actual pairs include those target_end_utc rows).

possible_explanations.statement: The spike could be related to changes in local generation availability or output in the window (descriptive SCADA changes include MACARTH1 change -186.6 MW [ev0949] and LOYYB1 change +547.5 MW [ev0946]).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Obtain formal generator outage/availability declarations and station availability records for the units with SCADA changes, and check unit outage timestamps against interval end 2026-08-19T23:10:00Z (2026-08-20 09:10 AEST).

possible_explanations.statement: The spike might be associated with interconnector flow limits or a binding constraint affecting imports/exports earlier than the market notice; the dispatch net interchange at the peak was -718.24 MW (net flow into VIC1) [ev0447].
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Retrieve constraint binding traces and the Network Outage Scheduler entries for the Hazelwood tie and interconnectors covering interval end 2026-08-19T23:10:00Z (2026-08-20 09:10 AEST) and the notice clock time 2026-08-20 11:00 AEST (UTC: 2026-08-20T01:00:00Z) to see whether any transfer limit or binding constraint was active before the peak.

possible_explanations.statement: The spike may reflect short‑duration offers or rebids in the five‑minute dispatch process, which are not visible in the retrieved aggregated data.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Examine AEMO rebid logs and offers/bids for the dispatch intervals around interval end 2026-08-19T23:10:00Z (2026-08-20 09:10 AEST) to identify any rapid bid changes that correspond to the high RRP.

citations.quote: At 1100 hrs 20/08/2026 there was a short notice outage of Hazelwood PS 4 6 bus tie 220kV.
citations.supports: AEMO market notice reporting a Hazelwood PS 4–6 bus tie outage and a constraint set invocation (notice for VIC1 within the event window).

uncertainties: Constraint binding traces and Network Outage Scheduler entries for the Hazelwood tie around and before 2026-08-19T23:10:00Z were not retrieved: thus the presence or timing of any binding transfer limit prior to the price peak is uncertain.
Rebid logs and formal unit outage declarations were not retrieved: the timing and intent of generator offer/bid changes or forced outages are therefore uncertain.
Generation_change output is descriptive SCADA and does not by itself indicate an outage or bidding intent (tool caveat).
missing_evidence: AEMO constraint binding traces and the Network Outage Scheduler entries for the Hazelwood PS tie covering times before and at 2026-08-19T23:10:00Z and including 2026-08-20T01:00:00Z (notice time).
AEMO rebid logs and offers/bids for dispatch intervals around 2026-08-19T23:10:00Z (2026-08-20 09:10 AEST).
Formal generator outage/availability declarations and station outage reports for units with notable SCADA changes in the window.
